environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate task in production VPC. Split.io SDK key is configured but the Split relay proxy endpoint is unreachable from the worker subnet (no NAT gateway route to Split's API). The environment variable SPLIT_DEFAULT_USE_LEGACY_QUERY_BUILDER is set to 'on' as a fallback during the migration period. Tasks are enqueued via Redis from the public-facing API which accepts user-controlled report_params including event_filter field.

config.network: worker subnet has no route to Split.io API endpoints
